task.title: Fresh portable package of main carrying the 2026-09-30 renderer and main-process changes, and its packaged gates
task.objective: Build a fresh portable package from a clean main (package:portable, strict offline validation in the pipeline) so the packaged tree carries the .modal-body line-break fix and the latencyClassId consolidation, commit the regenerated signed dependency manifest, and run the packaged gates against it: verify:ai-backend-pack-packaged (the one NOT RUN because the old package predated the fix), verify:ai-packaged-runtime, verify:ai-packaged-app, verify:ai-model-registration, verify:ai-progress-packaged, and the GPU packaged gates as AMD mechanics (NVIDIA stays BLOCKED, E11). Lease bookkeeping is committed before packaging so the manifest records a clean tree. No product code changes.

acceptance.description: A portable package built from a clean committed main passes the in-pipeline strict offline validation, and the regenerated signed manifest records sourceTreeDirty false.
The packaged gates pass on that artifact; the GPU packaged gates are AMD mechanics only, and NVIDIA stays BLOCKED.
The state documents record the package and the gates, and the dashboard's sources agree.
